recentItems.title: An update from the 12News Weather Impact Center | September 8, 2026
recentItems.description:
12News meteorologist Patrick Vaughn is in the Weather Impact Center to update you on the day's weather what's coming up for Southeast Texas.

Increasing chances for showers and thunderstorms are expected Thursday and Friday due to an upper-level disturbance that will move into the northwest gulf/coastal Texas coupled with prolific amounts of moisture. 

Scattered to occasionally numerous showers and thunderstorms will result with a 40% coverage possibly higher.  

Isolated, locally heavy rainfall will be possible.  

Afternoon highs will cool into the upper 80s to lower 90s.  
This weekend, rain chances drop to our normal 30% coverage as a weak upper-level disturbance drops south.
